definitions.full: H7959. shalu [ שָׁ֫לוּ Ges § 84 a c Lag BN:142] noun [masculine] ease, prosperity (Perles Anal. 80 delusion ; compare Aramaic שָׁלוּ error , below √, e.g., Gen 43:12 ); — suffix שַׁלְוִי Psa 30:7 (compare De Bae); < read שַׁלְוָתִי (or שַׁלְוֺתַי Bi), Ol Hup-Now Du and others (>Sta Hup think שׁלוי abbreviated from שׁלותי ).
